listings.description: Paco Rabanne Olympea Blossom. Paco Rabanne Olympea Blossom Eau de Parfum is a bright, feminine fragrance that gives the original Olympea character a fresher, fruitier twist. It opens with a lively blend of pink pepper and rose before moving into juicy pear and blackcurrant sorbet, creating a scent that feels sparkling, modern and easy to wear. A warm base of vanilla, cashmeran, salt and patchouli adds depth, helping the fragrance feel soft and sensual rather than overly sweet. . Ideal for customers who enjoy fruity floral perfumes with a confident finish, Olympea Blossom Perfume works beautifully as a daytime scent while still feeling polished enough for evenings.. Key Benefits. Fresh, fruity floral scent with rose, pear and blackcurrant sorbet for a bright opening.. Warm, sensual base with vanilla, cashmeran, salt and patchouli for added depth.. Eau de Parfum concentration for a more noticeable fragrance experience than lighter formats.. Versatile wear that suits everyday use, special occasions and gifting.. A modern take on Paco Rabanne Olympea Perfume , offering a softer, fruitier interpretation.. Distinctive bottle design , making it an attractive choice for a dressing table or fragrance gift.. Olympea Blossom is designed for shoppers who want a perfume that feels fresh, feminine and memorable without being too heavy. The fragrance opens with pink pepper and Damask rose, giving it a softly spiced floral lift. As it develops, pear and blackcurrant sorbet add a juicy, slightly tangy sweetness that makes the scent feel playful and contemporary.. The dry-down is where the fragrance becomes warmer and smoother. Vanilla brings softness, while cashmeran adds a clean woody feel. Salt and patchouli give the base more contrast, helping the perfume avoid feeling flat or overly sugary. The result is a fruity floral Eau de Parfum with a sensual edge, making Olympea Blossom a strong choice for fans of modern designer fragrances.. How To Use. Spray Paco Rabanne Olympea Blossom onto pulse points such as the wrists, neck and behind the ears. Apply to clean, dry skin and allow the fragrance to settle naturally rather than rubbing it in, as rubbing can affect how the notes develop.. For a softer daytime scent, use one or two sprays. For a more noticeable evening fragrance, apply lightly to additional pulse points or mist over clothing from a safe distance, avoiding delicate fabrics.. Who It's Best For. Paco Rabanne Olympea Blossom is best suited to customers who enjoy fruity floral perfumes with a warm, feminine base. It is a good option for those who like rose, pear, blackcurrant and vanilla notes, but want something with a slightly more polished designer feel.. It may be especially suitable for:. Everyday wear, workdays and casual plans.. Spring and summer fragrance wardrobes.. Evening occasions where a soft but noticeable scent is preferred.. Gifting for someone who already enjoys Paco Rabanne, Rabanne Olympea or fruity floral Eau de Parfums.. Customers looking for a fragrance that feels fresh at first, then warmer and smoother as it settles.. Specifications. Why Choose This Product. Choose Paco Rabanne Olympea Blossom if you want a designer Eau de Parfum that balances freshness, fruitiness and warmth. It offers the recognisable confidence of the Olympea fragrance line, but with a brighter floral-fruity character that feels easy to wear. The combination of rose, pear, blackcurrant sorbet and vanilla makes it appealing for shoppers who want a feminine scent that is sweet, polished and modern without feeling overpowering.. For customers comparing Olympea Blossom Perfume with other Paco Rabanne Olympea Perfume options, this version is a strong choice when you want something fresher, juicier and more sparkling, while still keeping the sensual warmth associated with the range..

listings.description: Pepe Jeans Celebrate for Her Eau de Parfum. Pepe Jeans Celebrate for Her Eau de Parfum is a warm, gourmand fragrance designed for women who enjoy sweet, cosy scents with a modern edge. It suits evening wear and cooler seasons, but works year-round if you prefer richer perfumes. This scent blends unusual edible notes with soft woods for a playful yet refined finish.. The fragrance opens with popcorn, chestnut and white pepper, creating a sweet yet slightly savoury first impression. The heart introduces caviar, water notes and immortelle for a unique twist. It dries down into vanilla, tonka bean, amber and cashmere wood, leaving a smooth, creamy trail with lasting warmth and depth. . Gourmand oriental vanilla fragrance with a cosy, modern feel. Notes include popcorn, chestnut, vanilla and tonka bean. Warm, creamy base with soft woody depth. Ideal for evening wear or autumn and winter. listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty Eau de Toilette 50ml. Discover the fresh, feminine character of Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty , a light and effortlessly elegant Eau de Toilette designed around sparkling fruits, delicate florals and soft, sensual woods. Presented in a 50ml spray bottle, this Calvin Klein fragrance is an easy addition to an everyday perfume collection.. Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty opens with a bright combination of juicy red berries, fresh bergamot and a sparkling Bellini accord. As the fragrance develops, a delicate floral heart comes forward, blending peony with jasmine and pink lily for a soft, graceful character.. The fragrance settles into a smooth base of musk, sandalwood and vanilla, adding gentle warmth and subtle sweetness while retaining the fresh feel of the scent.. Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty Fragrance Notes. Top notes: Bellini accord, bergamot and red berries Heart notes: Peony, jasmine and pink lily Base notes: Musk, sandalwood and vanilla. Why Choose Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty?. Fresh, floral and easy to wear, Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty Eau de Toilette is an appealing choice for anyone who enjoys feminine fragrances that balance fruity freshness with soft floral notes.. Its light character makes it particularly well suited to everyday wear, whether you're heading to work, meeting friends or looking for an understated fragrance for warmer days. The elegant 50ml bottle also makes it a thoughtful fragrance gift for a Calvin Klein fan.. How to Wear. Spray Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty lightly onto pulse points such as the wrists, neck and décolletage. Allow the fragrance to dry naturally rather than rubbing it into the skin, helping the different layers of the scent develop as intended.. Product details: . Brand: Calvin Klein. . Fragrance: Sheer Beauty. . Fragrance type: Eau de Toilette. . Size: 50ml. . Format: Spray. . Fragrance character: Fruity, floral and fresh. .

listings.description: La Perla Matte Silk Lipstick 3.5g. Elevate your makeup collection with La Perla Matte Silk Lipstick 3.5g , a luxury lipstick designed for sophisticated colour and refined elegance. Combining the modern appeal of a matte finish with the smooth look associated with silk-like texture, this lipstick delivers a polished appearance suitable for both everyday wear and special occasions.. Created for women who appreciate premium beauty products, the La Perla Matte Silk Lipstick offers a comfortable way to enhance your look while maintaining a timeless, elegant finish. Whether you're creating a subtle daytime makeup look or a more defined evening style, this lipstick is designed to complement a variety of occasions and beauty routines.. Key Benefits. Elegant matte finish for a sophisticated look. Smooth application for effortless wear. Suitable for day-to-evening makeup transitions. Luxury beauty product from the iconic La Perla brand. Compact 3.5g size ideal for handbags and travel. Helps create a polished and refined appearance. Suitable for a wide range of makeup styles. The La Perla Matte Lipstick is crafted for those who want the contemporary elegance of a matte lip without compromising on a refined finish. Its carefully designed formula glides onto the lips with ease, helping create even colour coverage and a sophisticated appearance.. Unlike traditional matte lip products that can sometimes appear flat, the La Perla Silk Lipstick concept focuses on combining rich colour payoff with a smoother-looking finish. The result is a lipstick that complements both minimalist makeup looks and more glamorous styling.. The sleek presentation reflects La Perla's reputation for luxury and attention to detail, making it a beautiful addition to any makeup collection. Whether paired with natural daytime makeup or a bold evening look, this La Perla Lipstick delivers versatile styling possibilities.. How To Use. Ensure lips are clean and dry before application.. Apply directly from the lipstick bullet, starting at the centre of the lips.. Work outward towards the corners for even coverage.. For greater precision, use a lip brush or lip liner before application.. Reapply as required throughout the day.. For a more defined finish, pair with a complementary lip liner and lightly blot between layers.. Who It's Best For. This lipstick is ideal for:. Women seeking a luxury lipstick experience. Those who prefer a sophisticated matte finish. Everyday makeup wearers looking for versatile colour. Special occasion and evening makeup enthusiasts. Shoppers seeking premium beauty gifts. Fans of designer beauty and luxury cosmetics. Its sophisticated matte finish, premium presentation and versatile wearability make it a valuable addition to any beauty collection.. Whether you're investing in a luxury makeup staple for yourself or searching for a thoughtful beauty gift, this lipstick offers the refined aesthetic and attention to detail associated with the La Perla name..
